name: v0
summary: Generates React and Tailwind interface code from a prompt or a screenshot, aimed at designers who ship.
description:
v0 earns its place by staying inside one stack: it writes React components with Tailwind and shadcn primitives, so output lands in a codebase that already looks like the rest of the product instead of needing a translation step. Screenshot-to-component and iterative refinement both work well for dashboards, settings screens and marketing pages.

It is a UI generator, not an application builder — business logic, data fetching and authentication are yours. And like anything that optimises for a specific component library, it produces the house style whether you want it or not, which is a feature for teams on shadcn and a limitation for anyone with their own design system.
